post.title: The US state closest to Africa is not Florida 🧭
post.premise: Florida is the state closest to Africa, right? Wrong, and the map shows why
post.bait: Did you guess Florida? Be honest 👇
post.description:
Everyone says Florida. The map says otherwise. This map story draws the shortest route from the United States to Africa, measures it, then draws Florida's for comparison, and explains why the curve of the Earth pulls the answer north.
Did you guess Florida? Be honest in the comments.
